row.body: A water bottle is marked for the household and paired with a field note that says the ground was too hot to cross after the crew left.
row.title: A parent’s water ration

sidecar.gloss: A family ration is left beside a route warning after a crew departs.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response team could have left water and recorded a dangerous route; the note does not identify the heat source.
